meta.title: Telemedicine demo for healthcare providers
meta.description: Interactive telemedicine demo with sample data: patient pre-visit form and consents, rule-based symptom guidance, a schedule without holidays, simulated video visit with chart, prescription and orders, SOAP notes, PDF summary, and payments with simulated invoice and RIPS.

header.title: Telemedicine for healthcare providers
header.subtitle: Walk through a telehealth day at {ips}: patient, clinician and billing.
header.simBadge: Simulated video, messages, payments and RIPS
header.resetHint: Restore the sample data and clear what you did in this browser

route.title: Suggested walkthrough (5 steps, under 5 minutes)
route.s1: As a patient, fill in the pre-visit form and accept the required consents.
route.s2: Describe symptoms: red flags are referred to the ER; everything else books the suggested specialty.
route.s3: As the clinician, refer the patient with chest pain and call Carlos Rodríguez.
route.s4: Review the chart and labs, record the diagnosis, sign the prescription and orders, and finish.
route.s5: Collect the copay with the simulated gateway and review the visit's invoice and RIPS.

queue.subtitle: Sorted by pre-visit priority and waiting time
queue.empty: No patients in the waiting room
queue.busy: Finish the current visit to call another patient.
queue.alarm: Red flag: not suitable for a video visit. The patient must go to the ER or call 123 (Colombia's emergency line).

refer.title: Refer to the ER
refer.body: {name} reported red-flag symptoms. A video visit is not the right channel: the patient is told to go to the ER or call 123, and it is recorded in the audit log.
refer.message: {name}, based on the symptoms you reported you need in-person care right away. Go to the nearest emergency room or call 123. Do not wait for the video visit.
refer.note: No real message is sent in the demo. In your project, the notice goes out via WhatsApp Business or SMS and your medical team defines the protocol.

triage.title: Symptom guidance
triage.subtitle: Describe how you feel and we suggest how soon to get care and with which specialty. It works with fixed sample rules.
triage.intro: Hi. Tell me your symptoms and since when. If it is an emergency, call 123.
triage.placeholder: E.g.: dry cough and fever for three days

examples.ex2: Chest pain and shortness of breath
examples.ex5: Diabetes and high blood pressure follow-up

triage.resultEmpty: Here you will see the suggested priority and the specialties to book.
triage.alarmTitle: Red flags: do not wait for a video visit
triage.alarmBody: Go to the nearest emergency room or call the emergency line.
triage.disclaimer: Guidance based on fixed sample rules: it does not use AI, it is not a diagnosis and it does not replace medical judgment. In your project, your medical team defines and validates the rules.

rules.chest: chest pain or shortness of breath
rules.neuro: fainting, seizure or loss of strength
rules.head: headache

reco.chest: These symptoms may be an emergency. Do not wait for a video visit: go to the ER or call 123.
reco.neuro: These symptoms may be an emergency. Go to the ER or call 123 right away.
reco.bleeding: Heavy bleeding needs in-person care right away: go to the ER or call 123.
reco.selfharm: What you feel matters and you do not have to go through it without help. Get help now: go to the ER or call 123.
reco.resp: We suggest a video visit today with general medicine. If you have trouble breathing, go to the ER.
reco.head: We suggest a video visit within 24 hours. If the pain is sudden and very intense, go to the ER.
reco.ear: You can book a video visit in the next few days with general medicine or pediatrics (for a child).
reco.skin: You can book dermatology in the next few days. Have a photo of the affected area ready.
reco.mental: You can book psychology. If at any time you think about harming yourself, get help right away.
reco.chronic: Book your follow-up with internal or general medicine and have your latest blood pressure and glucose readings ready.
reco.default: You can book a video visit with general medicine.

tele.title: Informed consent for telemedicine
tele.text: I understand the visit will be by video with {ips}, that the clinician may tell me to have an in-person visit or go to the ER if needed, and that I can withdraw this consent.

data.text: I authorize {ips} to process my personal and health data only for my care, medical record and billing. I can access, update and delete my data.

rec.title: Visit recording
rec.text: I authorize recording the video visit. If you do not authorize it, the clinician cannot record it.

patient.submit: Send and enter the waiting room
patient.submitHint: To send it you need the reason, the required details and both required consents.
patient.doneTitle: Done, {name}: you are in the waiting room.
patient.alarm: Your symptoms are red flags. Do not wait for the video visit: go to the ER or call 123.
patient.waMessage: Hi Carlos. {ips} is expecting you today at 10:30 for your general medicine video visit. Before joining, fill in your pre-visit form here:
patient.waNote: Sample message and link (they do not work outside the demo). In your project they are sent via WhatsApp Business or SMS.
patient.camSubtitle: Optional. Your browser will ask for permission.
patient.micLevel: Microphone level: speak to see it move
patient.camPrivacy: Video and sound stay in your browser: they are not recorded or sent to any server.

lab.title: Lab results
lab.subtitle: Sample results per patient and orders issued in the demo.
lab.note: In your project, results come from the lab through an integration (HL7 v2 or FHIR, if the lab supports it) or are uploaded as PDF.

billing.title: Payments and billing
billing.subtitle: Visits on {date}: service value, what the patient pays and what the payer covers.
billing.note: Sample values and rates. In each row, service value = what the patient pays + what the payer covers.
billing.gatewayNote: Simulated gateway: no payment details are requested or sent. In your project it connects to Wompi or PayU.
billing.ripsNote: Simplified, simulated RIPS (Colombia's health service record). In your project it is generated with the current structure and validated together with the healthcare e-invoice through your authorized provider.
billing.ripsNa: ER referrals do not generate an invoice or RIPS in this demo.

how.title: What is real in this demo and what we build in your project
how.subtitle: The demo runs entirely in your browser with sample data. This is what changes in an implementation for your organization.

video.title: Video visit
video.demo: the patient is a sample image; if your browser and the site allow it, you can turn on your camera and it shows only on your screen.
video.project: video between patient and clinician without installing apps, using a managed or self-hosted WebRTC service.

whatsapp.title: Reminders and links
whatsapp.demo: WhatsApp and email messages are shown but not sent.
whatsapp.project: sending via WhatsApp Business, SMS or email with your branding.

payments.title: Online payments
payments.demo: simulated gateway that marks the payment with a test reference.
payments.project: PSE, cards and digital wallets through Wompi or PayU.

invoice.title: Healthcare e-invoice and RIPS
invoice.demo: simplified, simulated invoice number and RIPS JSON.
invoice.project: healthcare e-invoice and RIPS through your authorized provider or our billing module.

signature.title: Signed prescriptions and orders
signature.demo: simulated signature and sample PDF generated in your browser.
signature.project: clinician e-signature with a signature provider and PDF stored in the medical record.

lab.title: Lab
lab.demo: sample results per patient and pending orders.
lab.project: integration with your lab (HL7 v2 or FHIR, if supported) or PDF upload.

records.title: Chart and visit record
records.demo: chart, pre-visit form, SOAP notes and ICD-10 from a reduced catalog; stored in this browser.
records.project: medical record kept according to regulations, or integration with the one you already use.

triage.title: Symptom guidance
triage.demo: fixed sample rules, no AI; red flags are referred to the ER.
triage.project: rules defined and validated by your medical team; optionally supported by supervised AI.

security.title: Audit and sensitive data
security.demo: log of every action in this session, with CSV export.
security.project: server-side access auditing, user roles, encryption in transit and at rest, and backups.

how.regulation: The platform is designed to support the requirements of Colombia's Resolution 2654 of 2019 (telehealth and telemedicine) and Law 1581 of 2012 (personal data). Enabling the telemedicine service is the provider's responsibility; each project's regulatory checklist is validated with its advisor.
